tagline: Designs, manufactures and supplies advanced custom-made printed circuit board solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal performance indicator reflecting revenue growth and demand for the company's advanced PCB solutions.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales realized by the company over the year.
kpis.description: Total revenue of $51.8 million in 2025, up 11% from $46.5 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Revenue growth attributed to increased demand and expanded production capacity.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin of 15.4% in 2025, down from 22.2% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Gross margin declined in 2025 due to increased labor costs, production inefficiencies, and dollar depreciation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin of 4.4% in 2025, down from 9.5% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Operating margin declined significantly in 2025 following gross margin compression.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Revenue less cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross profit of $8.0 million in 2025, down 23% from $10.3 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Gross profit declining in 2025 despite revenue growth, reflecting margin pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating profit of $2.3 million in 2025, down 48% from $4.4 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Operating profit down significantly in 2025 following gross profit decline.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses including sales, administration, and general expenses.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses of $5.6 million in 2025, slightly down from $5.8 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: SG&A expenses stable, with declines in management fees and executive incentives.

kpis.name: Cost of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Direct costs associated with production of goods sold.
kpis.description: Cost of revenue of $43.8 million in 2025, up 21% from $36.2 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Cost of revenue up 21% in 2025, driven by increased sales but also by production inefficiencies and exchange adjustments.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Expenditures for acquisition or modernization of physical assets and production equipment.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures estimated at $5 million for 2026, primarily for manufacturing equipment and facility expansion.
kpis.signal: Capital expenditures planned for 2026 to expand capacity and enhance technological capabilities.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total amount of liquid funds available on the balance sheet.
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents of $12.1 million as of December 31, 2025, down from $17.2 million as of December 31, 2024.
kpis.signal: Cash position declined in 2025, reflecting capital investments and operating activities.

kpis.name: Working Capital
kpis.explanation: Difference between current assets and current liabilities, indicator of operational liquidity.
kpis.description: Working capital of $25.0 million as of December 31, 2025, slightly down from $25.8 million as of December 31, 2024.
kpis.signal: Working capital stable, supporting current operations and growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Dependence on aging single-use machines
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned high in 'Risks Related to Our Business' section, repeated mention with strong language ('malfunction', 'cessation', 'material adverse effect'). Trend stable but with ongoing investments. Technology category is central to PCB operations.

risks.title: Sales concentration among few customers
risks.score_rationale: High position in document, precise numerical data (up to 18.3%), concerned language ('adverse impact', 'no assurance'). Trend stable. Competition category as linked to commercial negotiation and AVL.

risks.title: Dependence on few raw material suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Presented early with concrete data (35% of material costs from 2 suppliers), strong language ('delays', 'cancellation', 'no alternative'). Trend stable. Industrial category as central to production model.

risks.title: Rigid laminate shortage due to AI
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly linked to AI, highly marked language ('significant shortage', 'highly volatile'). Central position, high weight as impacts cost and production. Macro category as linked to global sector trend.

risks.title: Risks related to strict environmental regulations
risks.score_rationale: High position, mention of ISO 14001 and regulatory reform (integrated permit). Serious language ('fines', 'revocation'). Trend stable. Regulation category as linked to specific legal obligations for PCB sector.

risks.title: Complexity of manufacturing processes
risks.score_rationale: Strong language ('highly complex', 'defects', 'material adverse effect'). Recurring risk, linked to product nature. Technology category as linked to advanced PCB production processes.

risks.title: Threats to intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of potential ineffectiveness of IP protections and litigation risks. Concerned language ('not effective', 'infringe'). Trend stable. Technology category as central to PCB innovation.

risks.title: Low-cost Asian competition
risks.score_rationale: Direct mention of Asian competition with cost disadvantage. Clear language ('lower than ours'). High position. Competition category as structural factor of PCB market.

ai_positioning.summary: Eltek makes no mention of any artificial intelligence strategy or initiative in its financial documents.
evidence: No mention of AI or related technologies in Form 20-F 2025
No references to products or services incorporating AI
Absence of R&D oriented toward AI or advanced automation
